summary.text: Randy Bridges is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 3 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Michael McVicker.
He is a real estate developer and broker.

paragraphs.text: Randy Bridges was born in Paducah, Kentucky.

His career experience includes working as a real estate developer, broker, and owner of Remax Realty Group, and he has been a member of the Paducah Board of Realtors, the Rotary Club of Paducah and the Paducah Area Chamber of Commerce, among other organizations.
Bridges succeeded Democrat Gerald Watkins in District 3.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Appropriations and Revenue, House Natural Resources and Energy and House Transportation committees, and in 2023-2024 he chaired the House Local Government Committee.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been married for more than 44 years, that his priorities include workforce development, housing and lowering the state income tax, and that he has lived in Paducah and McCracken County since birth.
